name: Nest Thermostat 2020 (US)

radios.note: Google lists Wi-Fi 802.11n. Google's information menu mentions Thread addressing, but no maker page we saw lists a Thread radio, so it is left out.

matter.note: CSA lists a Google Nest Thermostat as Matter certified over Wi-Fi; the listing does not state the 2020 model number, so verify it is this one. Google's update history shows Matter arrived in version 1.3-10 (June 2023).

apple_home.note: Through Matter: add it to Google Home first, then link it to Apple Home. Google caps a thermostat at 5 Matter apps. Needs an Apple home hub.

google_home.note: Set up and controlled in the Google Home app.

alexa.note: Google's Nest skill for Alexa covers Nest thermostats; the page does not name this model, so confirm in the Alexa app.

smartthings.note: No Google or Samsung page found lists this model. Only a SmartThings forum post mentions a Nest thermostat over Matter.

home_assistant.note: Official Google Nest integration using the Smart Device Management API; Google charges a one-time US$5 Device Access fee. Matter is a second route.

hubRequired.note: Connects over Wi-Fi and is set up in the Google Home app; no bridge needed.

localControl.note: No maker source states what works without internet. Home Assistant's Nest integration is cloud-based.

systems.value: Most 24 V systems, incl. heat pumps
systems.note: Google lists most 24 V systems (gas, electric, oil, forced air, heat pump, radiant). Use g.co/nest/works to check yours.

power.value: HVAC wires; C-wire may be needed
power.note: Google says it is designed to run without a C-wire, with AAA batteries as backup, but a C-wire or power accessory may be needed for heat-only, cool-only or zoned systems.

summary: Google Home runs the Nest Thermostat (2020), a US wall thermostat that gained Matter in a June 2023 update. Matter is what lets it pair with Apple Home, and Home Assistant has an official Nest integration. It is built to work without a C-wire, though some systems still need one. SmartThings support is not confirmed.
caveats: Matter came in a 2023 firmware update; older firmware will not offer it.
Google says heat-only, cool-only and zone-controller systems may need a C-wire or other power accessory.
Low power can disable features including Matter, per Google's Nest Power Connector page.
